issue.pro.sd-boot.title: The device may still boot from eMMC after writing the SD image
issue.pro.sd-boot.description: You selected an SD card image. The current firmware has not passed the SD-first boot check, so the device may still start from eMMC after installation. Choose Review repair in the action bar to review the SD-first boot update.
issue.pro.sd-boot.solution:
1. Choose Review repair in the action bar, review the SD-first boot update and confirm.

2. After the update, run checks again and continue installing the selected SD image.

3. Keep the SD card inserted and reboot after installation. The SD card takes priority; without a card, the factory eMMC system starts.
issue.pro.sd-files.title: The OneKVM SD boot files could not be read
issue.pro.sd-files.description: The device is running from eMMC. An inserted card has the OneKVM Pro SD identifier, but its expected boot layout or files could not be read. This does not establish a boot-priority problem.
issue.pro.sd-files.solution:
1. Verify that you downloaded the SD image for this exact model and that its checksum matches.

2. Shut down the device and reflash the complete .img file to the SD card using a card reader. Let the flashing tool finish its verification.

3. Reinsert the card and power on the device. If boot files still cannot be read, try another card or reader.

These checks only provide guidance. They do not format the card, change boot settings, or write firmware.

issue.pro.sd-boot.firmware.title: Enable SD-first boot
issue.pro.sd-boot.firmware.solution:
Choose Review repair in the action bar to review the SD-first boot update. The installer checks the selected image and device, then asks you to review and confirm before updating boot firmware.

The factory system and boot settings are preserved. Continue installing the SD image after the update, and reboot once installation is complete.

Update boot firmware to enable SD-first boot. The factory system and boot settings are preserved.

With an SD card inserted, its system takes priority. Without a card, the factory eMMC system starts. Review the details below and keep power connected during the update.
